title: Built this using Codex + free arts and sounds assets. Fails to replicate it in Unreal 5.8 using their new MCP.
author: Total-Trash8491
selftext:
[https://rajahafify.itch.io/orbital](https://rajahafify.itch.io/orbital)

It’s pure HTML, CSS, and JS, and it started as a prototype for the final game I want to build in Unreal Engine using the newly revealed UE 5.8 MCP for a game jam.

It was my first time using Unreal and the MCP, and I couldn’t get it to a level I was happy with in time. I downloaded a lot of assets from the Unreal Fab store, but some of them didn’t work properly, so the project ended up looking like a bit of a mess.

In the end, I polished up the HTML version and submitted that instead.

That said, I genuinely felt much more empowered using the Unreal MCP compared with the one I tested in Godot. Having an MCP officially supported by the editor developer feels like a real step forward. And the Unreal Fab store opens up so many visual possibilities.

I think we’re definitely going to see an explosion of FlipSlop™ games, trademark pending 😄. But I also think this will help a future generation of game devs build their next great game.

I hope that’s me.
